name: player_standard_5
description: The app (real Flutter build, live WinRT capture off the mimic player window) against the golden the CLI's replay path produced from the same clip. Settings are 'fresh' on purpose: an empty settings box yields the app's documented defaults -- detail-crop calibration on and the frame resize on -- which is the only config a run can be attributed to; 'copy' would carry whatever this machine's installation happens to hold. Those are also the CLI's defaults (--frame-resize, --no-frame-resize to turn it off), and this case states frame_resize true in native/test/integration/cases.json, so the golden is a baseline for the same configuration and a mismatch is the app's, not a config difference. Not re-run since the frame resize started defaulting on.
